title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — paragraph 1
obligation_snippet: Where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject, the controller shall, at the time when personal data are obtained, provide the data subject with all of the followin

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 1(a)
obligation_snippet: the identity and the contact details of the controller;

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 1(b)
obligation_snippet: the contact details of the data protection officer, where applicable;

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 1(c)
obligation_snippet: the purposes of the processing and the legal basis;

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 1(d)
obligation_snippet: where processing is based on Art.6(1)(f), the legitimate interests pursued;

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 1(e)
obligation_snippet: the recipients or categories of recipients;

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 1(f)
obligation_snippet: where applicable, that the controller intends to transfer personal data to a third country.

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — paragraph 2
obligation_snippet: In addition to the information in paragraph 1, the controller shall provide the following further information: (a) the period for which personal data will be stored; (b) where processing is based on c

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 2(a)
obligation_snippet: In addition to the information in paragraph 1, the controller shall provide the following further information: (a) the period for which personal data will be stored;

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 2(b)
obligation_snippet: In addition to the information in paragraph 1, the controller shall provide the following further information: (b) where processing is based on consent, the right to withdraw consent at any time;

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 2(c)
obligation_snippet: In addition to the information in paragraph 1, the controller shall provide the following further information: (c) the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority;

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 2(d)
obligation_snippet: In addition to the information in paragraph 1, the controller shall provide the following further information: (d) whether the provision of personal data is a statutory or contractual requirement;

title: Information to be provided where personal data are collected from the data subject — 2(e)
obligation_snippet: In addition to the information in paragraph 1, the controller shall provide the following further information: (e) the existence of automated decision-making including profiling.

title: Right of access by the data subject — paragraph 1
obligation_snippet: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller confirmation as to whether or not personal data concerning him or her are being processed, and, where that is the case, access to th

title: Right of access by the data subject — 1(a)
obligation_snippet: the purposes of the processing;

title: Right of access by the data subject — 1(b)
obligation_snippet: the categories of personal data concerned;

title: Right of access by the data subject — 1(c)
obligation_snippet: the recipients or categories of recipient;

title: Right of access by the data subject — 1(d)
obligation_snippet: the envisaged period for which personal data will be stored;

title: Right of access by the data subject — 1(e)
obligation_snippet: the existence of the right to request rectification, erasure or restriction, or to object;

title: Right of access by the data subject — 1(f)
obligation_snippet: the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority;

title: Right of access by the data subject — 1(g)
obligation_snippet: where data not collected from the data subject, available information as to their source;

title: Right of access by the data subject — 1(h)
obligation_snippet: the existence of automated decision-making including profiling.

title: Right of access by the data subject — paragraph 3
obligation_snippet: The controller shall provide a copy of the personal data undergoing processing.

title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority — paragraph 1
obligation_snippet: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the personal data breach to the sup

title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority — paragraph 2
obligation_snippet: The processor shall notify the controller without undue delay after becoming aware of a personal data breach.

title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority — paragraph 3
obligation_snippet: The notification referred to in paragraph 1 shall at least: (a) describe the nature of the breach including categories and approximate number of data subjects concerned; (b) communicate the name and c

title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority — 3(a)
obligation_snippet: describe the nature of the personal data breach including where possible, the categories and approximate number of data subjects concerned;

title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority — 3(b)
obligation_snippet: communicate the name and contact details of the DPO or other contact point;

title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority — 3(c)
obligation_snippet: describe the likely consequences of the personal data breach;

title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority — 3(d)
obligation_snippet: describe the measures taken or proposed to be taken to address the breach including, where appropriate, measures to mitigate its possible adverse effects.

title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority — paragraph 5
obligation_snippet: The controller shall document any personal data breaches, comprising the facts relating to the personal data breach, its effects and the remedial action taken.
